# gzip

```go
import "github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/compress/gzip"
```

Package gzip is a gashe.Compressor based on gzip, from the standard library only: for large values, less memory in the backend and less traffic. compress/zstd stores about the same and is faster.

## type [Compressor](<https://github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/blob/main/compress/gzip/gzip.go#L18-L21>)
